purpose: Proposed challenge-only scenario record; not a QMX persisted contract or CT id.
record_rule: Each following line is one scenario object. Arrays contain non-empty strings. Unknown evidence is stated, never inferred.

field_definitions.id: string; stable challenge-local P1/P2 scenario id
field_definitions.user_goal: string; operator outcome in domain language
field_definitions.source: string; requirement, assumption, evidence, or candidate seam
field_definitions.forbidden_effects: string[]; effects that must not occur
field_definitions.oracle_evidence: string[]; evidence that can decide pass/refuse/recovery
field_definitions.contracts_owners: string[]; proposed or inherited owners; not newly minted CT ids
field_definitions.failure_recovery: string; typed failure and recovery expectation
field_definitions.evidence_status: string; baseline/candidate origin and execution status
